1 Introduction

Transformer decoders struggle to carry information across long distances.

We argue for a different decomposition of long-context.

2 Related Work

2.1 Retrieval-augmented LMs

RAG systems concatenate retrieved tokens into the prompt.

2.2 Long-context attention

Landmark attention uses discrete anchor tokens.

Mamba replaces attention with state-space models.

3 Method

We store a low-rank projection of each past chunk.
